# Bootstrap of the account dev

This root module prepares the AWS account `222222222222` (dev) one time, before CI can deploy.
It writes the state bucket `order-web-dev-tfstate-222222222222`, the GitHub OIDC identity provider and the IAM roles for CI.

The toolchain does not create AWS accounts.
The account must exist in AWS Organizations before the bootstrap.

## Apply the module

Use the credentials of an administrator of the account `222222222222`.
The module starts with local state in the file `terraform.tfstate` of this folder.

1. Go to this folder.
2. Run `tofu init`.
3. Run `tofu apply -var "model_commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" -var "github_repository=<owner>/<name>"`.

Use the GitHub repository of the model for `<owner>/<name>`.

## Move the state into the state bucket

1. Make the file `backend.tf` in this folder with this text:

   ```hcl
   terraform {
     backend "s3" {
       bucket       = "order-web-dev-tfstate-222222222222"
       key          = "bootstrap/terraform.tfstate"
       region       = "eu-west-1"
       encrypt      = true
       use_lockfile = true
     }
   }
   ```

2. Run `tofu init -migrate-state`.
3. Type `yes` when OpenTofu asks if it can copy the state.
4. Delete the files `terraform.tfstate` and `terraform.tfstate.backup` of this folder.
5. Commit the file `backend.tf`.

The generator does not change the file `backend.tf`.
With Terraform, use `terraform` in place of `tofu` in the commands.
